title: WS-040 - Set a dashboard link for a survey
intent: Explain how to set the dashboard link associated with a survey.
short_answer: Use SetDashboardLink to set the dashboard link for a survey. The endpoint uses PUT and returns no content on success. API summary Status Active Endpoint <base_url>/webservice/SetDashboardLink/[Alias] Supported method(s) PUT Required privilege Authenticated system user allowed for the survey Parameters and input Alias Survey alias. Body Dashboard URL according to the implementation introduced for this method. Expected output Returns HTTP 204 with no content on success. Main HTTP responses 204 No Content Dashboard link set successfully. 412 Precondition Failed Survey does not exist. 403 Forbidden Wrong username/password, missing required privilege, or user not allowed to perform the operation. 404 Not Found Unknown service or missing parameters. 412 Precondition Failed A prerequisite is not met, such as missing survey, wrong parameter format, archived survey, or invalid identifier. 429 Too Many Requests Daily API request limit exceeded.
